channel.title: Treease Changelog
channel.description: New updates and product improvements in Treease.

item.title: A clearer changelog, better discoverability, and easier feedback
item.description: Treease now makes product updates easier to find, improves search discoverability, and provides a convenient BugDrop dialog for reporting issues.

item.title: Faster graphs and more reliable sessions
item.description: Large graph scenes render more efficiently, streaming tables stay stable, and rate-limited usage requests now recover more gracefully.

item.title: More dependable accounts, usage limits, and streaming graphs
item.description: Account identity, metering, billing webhooks, and streamed graph updates now behave more consistently across anonymous and signed-in sessions.

item.title: Smoother sign-in, sharing, and editor navigation
item.description: Treease improves authentication recovery, anonymous usage visibility, graph sharing restoration, and everyday editor navigation.

item.title: Improved account navigation, checkout, and workspace actions
item.description: Treease makes account management and pricing checkout more context-aware, improves AI credential routing, and clarifies desktop file actions.

item.title: Faster streamed imports and desktop workspaces
item.description: Streamed trace imports are faster, and the desktop experience now has a workspace host with a release-ready workflow.

item.title: Accounts, sharing, analytics, and pricing flows
item.description: Treease adds the core account, sharing, analytics, and pricing experiences needed for a more complete hosted product.

item.title: Clearer structured comparison diffs
item.description: JSON comparisons now use explicit byte spans, making changed regions more accurate and easier to review.

item.title: More stable graph rendering and workspace resizing
item.description: Graph readiness and workspace resizing are more dependable, with fewer timing-related rendering issues.

item.title: Standalone API service
item.description: Treease now provides a standalone API service for integrations and programmatic access.

item.title: More complete initial example loading
item.description: The initial example now follows the same editing and language-service path as later changes, producing a more consistent first experience.

item.title: URL presets, tutorials, and a smoother editor
item.description: Treease adds reusable tutorials and URL-backed editor presets while improving graph search, import progress, pane behavior, CLI rendering, and editor motion.

item.title: Clearer CLI help and asset downloads
item.description: The CLI now reports its version in help output and shows progress while downloading required assets.

item.title: More reliable web runtime behavior
item.description: Web asset checks, hover imports, runtime readiness, and end-to-end interactions are now more stable.

item.title: A more dependable subgraph workspace
item.description: Subgraph editing, missing-cell handling, graph edges, and formatting now behave more predictably across complex documents.

item.title: Improved CLI version support and graph relayout
item.description: The CLI handles version information more consistently and produces improved graph layouts.

item.title: More consistent CLI parsing and input handling
item.description: The CLI fixes parsing regressions, clarifies null input behavior, and removes the obsolete examples doctor command.

item.title: Preserved highlights when switching examples
item.description: Changing language examples now keeps the relevant editor highlight instead of losing visual context.

item.title: JSONL imports, faster analysis, and improved CLI workflows
item.description: Treease expands import support, improves streamed analysis and synchronization, and delivers a more capable CLI and web graph route.

item.title: Treease launches
item.description: Treease introduces a structured-text editor that turns nested data into an interactive tree and graph.
